items.subject: A large laboratory high-voltage resonance coil: a tall cylinder wound with fine shiny copper wire, a polished aluminium toroid ring on top, white ceramic insulator stacks, a heavy octagonal machined steel base plinth with bolts, deep red painted accents on the base

A giant upright U-shaped horseshoe magnet monument standing on its curved base: one leg glossy red painted steel and the other glossy blue painted steel, bright polished silver pole tips at the top ends, a band of copper coil windings wrapped around each leg, mounted on a heavy machined steel plinth
A cluster of large translucent rose-red quartz crystal points growing upward from a dark rock base, sharp faceted hexagonal prisms of different heights, glassy with internal veils
A cluster of large translucent ice-blue quartz crystal points growing upward from a dark rock base, sharp faceted hexagonal prisms of different heights, glassy with internal veils

A floating rock island: an inverted jagged cone of dark layered slate stone, a flat top with a few small dark pine trees and a cluster of rose-red quartz crystals, a small copper coil pylon at the edge

A floating rock island: an inverted jagged cone of dark layered slate stone, a flat top with a few small dark pine trees and a cluster of ice-blue quartz crystals, a small steel antenna mast at the edge
